exposure: Axillary or rectal body temperature recorded at admission
outcome: Composite adverse outcome (mortality, severe neurological injury, severe retinopathy of prematurity, necrotizing enterocolitis, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, nosocomial infection)
cohort: The study included 9833 inborn infants born at fewer than 33 weeks' gestation, admitted to 29 neonatal intensive care units in Canada between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2012.
finding: The relationship between admission temperature and adverse neonatal outcomes was U-shaped, with the lowest rates of adverse outcomes associated with admission temperatures between 36.5°C and 37.2°C.
